title: Quantifier bits in a paired encoding
statement: Let $x$ and $q$ be finite bit strings, and let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over natural-number variables. If $x$ is the pairing of $q$ with the binary encoding of $\varphi$, then for every index $k<|q|$, the bits of $x$ at positions $2k$ and $2k+1$ both equal the $k$th bit of $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is the pairing of $q$ with the encoding of $\varphi$
